claims.claim: grounded_query_planning.py and product_intelligence exports add exactly GroundedQueryPlanningError and plan_grounded_retrieval_query, with no planner result, score, configuration, provider, model, or product-selection authority.

The planner validates exact nonblank <=4096-byte question input, segments only maximal original str.isalnum() runs in source order, rejects zero-run or >24-run questions, and performs no local TASK-122 normalization or stop-word semantics.

Candidate queries are only contiguous original-token spans of length 1..12, evaluated by descending length then ascending start, with no reordering, non-contiguous term selection, spelling/case rewrite, or fabricated tokens.

Every corpus-aware candidate evaluation delegates to retrieve_canonical_variant_profiles(corpus, query=candidate, limit=2), uses no private retrieval helper/direct profile search, and lets CanonicalProfileRetrievalError propagate under TASK-122 authority.

Query selection follows exactly unique identity-bearing > unique any-field > multiple, then longer span > earlier start; identity-bearing means only an existing witness field in TITLE/BRAND/MODEL_SKU/MEDIA_VARIANT_LABEL and creates no identity/truth claim.

If every candidate is a no-hit and question length is <=12 lexical runs, planner returns the complete lexical question as fallback; if every candidate is a no-hit and question length is >12, it fails closed without arbitrary truncation or hidden term deletion.
Empty corpus, repeated calls, and corpus permutations are deterministic; planner neither mutates inputs nor returns/reuses TASK-122 hits as context evidence.

TASK-121/122/123/124/129/131/132/133, M2 ranking/approval, and M3 product/evidence authority remain unchanged; planner performs no model/provider/AgentLoop, direct product ranking, storage, network, browser, environment, clock/random/UUID, or product-truth reconciliation work.
Focused offline regressions and documentation certify AC1-AC8, existing TASK-122, TASK-123, and TASK-133 focused tests remain passing, and git diff integrity passes.
